Accepted-set conditional error need not be monotone in a score threshold, so the generic algorithm cannot be attached without a matching formulation. Risk is FOR=P(Y=1|s(X)<tau) in the negative-action subset. No certificate means fallback policy, not per-item abstention. Query separation and constructed retrieval mixtures limit transfer; no empirical score/multiplier imported or local reproduction. entries.name: Jev / TypeSafe

summary.en: Hosted typed judgments: probabilities over supplied choices, propositions and ordinal rubrics.
summary.zh: 托管的结构化判断服务：对选项、命题与有序评分标准输出分布。

use.en: Managed typed-judgment comparator or frozen semantic-feature generator; compare supervised baselines under the same task and label policy.
use.zh: 可作为托管类型化判断对照或冻结的语义特征提取器；与监督基线比较时统一任务与标签规则。

caveat.en: RLCD is vendor-described; the full training recipe is not public. Valid schemas and confidence fields do not establish semantic reliability.
caveat.zh: RLCD 的完整训练配方未公开；格式合法与置信度字段不等于语义可靠。

mechanism.en: Proprietary model. Choice/Score confidence summarizes the returned distribution; it is not a separate probability-of-correctness estimate. Noul returns P(yes) with no separate confidence field. Question IDs are not model input; each instruction must be complete. Same-request answers are documented as independent; dependent evidence requires a later request.
mechanism.zh: 专有模型。Choice／Score 的 confidence 是返回分布的统计量，并非独立预测的正确概率；Noul 返回 P(yes)，没有单独 confidence 字段。 文档称问题 ID 不送入模型，instructions 须写完整；同请求答案互不作为上下文，依赖新证据的判断需后续请求。

training.en: Vendor-described RLCD; controlled independent ablations not established here.
training.zh: 官方称采用 RLCD；本版未取得受控独立消融证据。

availability.en: Hosted API; no public weights verified.
availability.zh: 托管 API；本版未核实公开权重。

entries.license_note: Commercial service terms; no open-weight license implied.

scale.en: Not publicly established by the reviewed material.
scale.zh: 核对的公开资料未明确参数规模。

entries.name: Laya

summary.en: Compact encoder family with dynamic option heads; general, multilingual and workflow-specialized checkpoints.
summary.zh: 小型编码器与动态选项判断头；包含通用、多语言及工作流专项检查点。

use.en: Narrow, high-volume judgments with domain training and measured hardware costs.
use.zh: 适合有领域训练数据、需要控制高频调用成本的窄域判断。

caveat.en: Do not mix base/specialist scores; the typed card discloses training/calibration overlap and inherited-temperature conflicts. Boolean labels can dominate noul/choice; semantic labels alone do not make negation safe. action.act_probability is documented as nearly constant at 1 and unsuitable as an execution gate. Validate confidence on your workload instead.
caveat.zh: 不可混用基础版／专项版成绩；专项卡披露训练／校准重叠和继承温度冲突。布尔标签可能主导 noul／choice；语义标签也不能保证否定句安全。官方称 action.act_probability 几乎恒为 1，不适合作为执行门槛；confidence 也需在实际任务上验证。

mechanism.en: Bidirectional encoder plus option-conditioned decision head.
mechanism.zh: 双向编码器加选项条件化判断头。

training.en: Proper-score rewards and policy gradients; the typed specialist also uses soft cross-entropy. Not a confirmed reproduction of Jev training.
training.zh: 适当评分奖励与策略梯度；专项训练还使用软交叉熵。不是已确认的 Jev 训练复现。

availability.en: Local weights/runtime; checkpoint and language must be selected explicitly.
availability.zh: 本地权重与运行库；应明确检查点及语言。

entries.license_note: Reviewed family/specialist cards declare Apache-2.0; verify each selected artifact.

scale.en: English and workflow specialist: about 421M; multilingual: about 322M.
scale.zh: 英语及专项版约 421M；多语言版约 322M。

entries.name: Kev

summary.en: Qwen-based typed decision family with a dynamic pointer head; Kev 1.0 freezes existing checkpoints as a release baseline.
summary.zh: Qwen 骨干与动态 pointer head 的类型化判断系列；Kev 1.0 将现有检查点固定为发布基线。

use.en: An inspectable starting point for domain-supervised decision models.
use.zh: 可检查、可微调的领域监督判断实验底座。

caveat.en: Keep trained-family tests separate from transfer. 27B v2 is worse and overconfident on long contracts (CUAD ECE 0.053 versus v1 0.007). Serving capacity and fitted temperature do not guarantee accuracy or calibration on new workloads.
caveat.zh: 须区分训练任务族测试与迁移测试。27B v2 在长合同上退步且过度自信（CUAD ECE 0.053，v1 为 0.007）；可接收长度和拟合温度不保证新任务的准确率或校准。

mechanism.en: Dynamic option readout on a language-model backbone; several model sizes.
mechanism.zh: 在语言模型骨干上动态读出选项分数；提供多个规模。

training.en: 0.8B/4B/9B use LoRA plus a head. 27B v2 fully fine-tunes Qwen3.8-27B, then averages weights 0.85/0.15 with v1. Temperature fitting is distribution-specific; 0.8B/4B use held-out items from trained families. Oct22 adaptation scripts distinguish full question/rubric identity, keep state variants in one split, and reject exact fractional JSON ordinal labels before float rounding. Data-contract fixes, not a weight release.
training.zh: 0.8B／4B／9B 使用 LoRA 与判断头；27B v2 全参数微调 Qwen3.8-27B，再按 0.85／0.15 与 v1 平均权重。温度拟合依赖分布；0.8B／4B 使用训练任务族的保留样本。 10 月 22 日适配脚本按完整问题／rubric 判冲突、同状态变体不跨划分，并在浮点舍入前拒绝真实小数序数标签；这是数据契约修复，不是权重发布。

availability.en: Small releases require the base plus adapter/head; 27B v2 ships about 51 GB of full bf16 weights plus head. Served limit: 65,536 tokens. Author-validated CUAD context: 8,192 for 0.8B/4B/9B, 65,536 for 27B, under the stated 3-pp non-inferiority rule. Current server supports explicit CPU/accelerator selection and isolated fail-closed probes; those probes do not validate every kernel.
availability.zh: 小型号需基座、适配器与判断头；27B v2 发布约 51 GB 的完整 bf16 权重与判断头。服务上限 65,536 token；按作者 CUAD 的 3 个百分点非劣效规则，0.8B／4B／9B 仅验证至 8,192，27B 至 65,536。 当前服务支持明确 CPU／加速器选择及隔离 fail-closed 探测；探测不验证所有内核。

entries.license_note: Kev 1.0 cards declare Apache-2.0 for the released weights/head and listed bases; verify the exact artifact. A family entry has no single weight revision.

scale.en: Released family spans 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B; inspect the exact backbone/card.
scale.zh: 公开系列覆盖 0.8B、4B、9B、27B；须核对具体骨干与模型卡。

entries.name: Contrastive Language Models (CLM)

summary.en: Separate state and action representations with learned projection heads on a frozen language-model encoder.
summary.zh: 冻结语言模型编码器，分别表示状态与动作，再用可训练投影头匹配。

use.en: Reusable candidate catalogs, tool selection and domain-trained Best-of-N selection.
use.zh: 适合候选可复用的工具目录、排序及领域 Best-of-N 选择。

caveat.en: Relative ranking cannot detect every all-wrong candidate set. Best-of-N scores include supplied candidates, not autonomous task-solving ability.
caveat.zh: 相对排序不能保证识别“全部候选都错”；Best-of-N 成绩不代表模型独立解题能力。

mechanism.en: Dual encoding permits candidate caching; released base uses frozen Qwen3-8B.
mechanism.zh: 双侧编码允许缓存候选；发布的基础版使用冻结 Qwen3-8B。

training.en: Contrastive InfoNCE with negatives; specialized heads require their own evidence.
training.zh: 含负例的 InfoNCE 对比学习；专项投影头需单独评测。

availability.en: Local code and weights; backbone still runs at inference.
availability.zh: 公开代码与权重；推理仍需运行骨干。

entries.license_note: Base card: Apache-2.0. Reviewed DeepSWE head card: MIT. Do not assign one license to the whole family.

scale.en: 8B base encoder plus learned heads in the reviewed release.
scale.zh: 本版核对的发布使用 8B 骨干及可训练投影头。

entries.name: Bespoke Nimble

summary.en: Qwen-based supervised adapter that reads answer-label logits instead of generating an explanation.
summary.zh: Qwen 监督适配器，直接读取答案标签 logits，而非生成解释。

use.en: A transparent baseline for evidence-sensitive judgments and minimal-edit training examples.
use.zh: 适合证据敏感的判断，也可借鉴最小差异训练样本。

caveat.en: Contrastive data construction is not CLM-style contrastive embedding training. Public benchmark reporting is author-run and raw run outputs are not all committed.
caveat.zh: 对比式样本构造不等于 CLM 的对比表示训练；公开比较由项目方运行，完整逐行输出并未全部提交。

mechanism.en: Qwen3.5-9B plus LoRA, scoring allowed answer tokens.
mechanism.zh: Qwen3.5-9B 加 LoRA，对允许的答案 token 评分。

training.en: Supervised learning; minimal changes to decisive evidence help define the boundary.
training.zh: 监督学习；用决定性证据的最小变化构造判断边界。

availability.en: Adapter and code are public; load the base model as well.
availability.zh: 公开适配器与代码；仍需加载基础模型。

entries.license_note: Reviewed model card declares Apache-2.0; inherited dependencies retain their terms.

scale.en: 9B backbone plus adapter; adapter bytes alone are not required memory.
scale.zh: 9B 骨干加适配器；适配器文件大小不等于所需内存。

entries.name: GLiNER2.5-Decide

summary.en: Schema-conditioned local classification with runtime labels and multiple decision heads.
summary.zh: 通过运行时标签与多个判断头实现模式条件化的本地分类。

use.en: Compact operational classification; inspect the runtime for supported cross-field constraints.
use.zh: 适合轻量业务分类；跨字段约束需核对具体运行库支持。

caveat.en: This review inspected the 1B card, which cross-reports 340M results. Dataset audit is incomplete; JevK5 in that table is not TypeSafe Jev.
caveat.zh: 本版核对的是 1B 模型卡，其中交叉报告 340M 成绩；数据集审计未完成，表中 JevK5 不是 TypeSafe Jev。

mechanism.en: Encoder-style classification; single-label and multilabel outputs.
mechanism.zh: 编码器式分类；支持单标签与多标签输出。

training.en: Treat checkpoint-specific training details as documented, not inferred from sibling models. Oct20 runtime fixes distributed gradient synchronization; audit prior multi-GPU adaptation runs. Published checkpoint exposure to this defect is unknown; no inferred retraining or gain.
training.zh: 训练细节按具体检查点文档记录，不从同系列模型推断。 10 月 20 日运行库修复多卡梯度同步，既有分布式适配运行应核查；公开检查点是否受影响未知，不推断已重训或性能提升。

availability.en: Published checkpoints; current runtime supports Transformers 5 and schema-extraction loading. Match runtime, checkpoint config and classify_text examples; unchanged LFS weight identity across the watched revisions.
availability.zh: 公开检查点；当前运行库支持 Transformers 5 与 schema-extraction 加载。须匹配运行库、检查点配置及 classify_text 示例；所监测两版本的 LFS 权重标识相同。

entries.license_note: Reviewed 1B card declares Apache-2.0; other checkpoints need separate checks.

scale.en: 1B card directly reviewed; 340M and 287M sibling results/links are cross-reported there.
scale.zh: 直接核对 1B 卡；340M 与 287M 同系列资料由该卡交叉报告。

entries.name: GLiClass

summary.en: Label-conditioned text classification with user-supplied labels, including multilabel tasks.
summary.zh: 以用户提供的标签为条件进行文本分类，包含多标签任务。

use.en: An adjacent baseline for dynamic intent and label classification.
use.zh: 动态意图与标签分类的重要相邻基线。

caveat.en: Classification capability does not establish general workflow verification or calibrated operational risk.
caveat.zh: 分类能力不等于通用工作流验收能力，也不保证业务风险已校准。

mechanism.en: Joint text/label representation and label scoring.
mechanism.zh: 联合表示文本与标签，再对标签评分。

training.en: Consult the selected checkpoint; do not attribute every GLiClass variant one recipe.
training.zh: 以具体检查点为准，不给所有版本统一指定训练配方。

availability.en: Open repository with links to model checkpoints.
availability.zh: 公开仓库，并链接模型检查点。

entries.license_note: Consult repository and chosen checkpoint license; not fully audited in this edition.

scale.en: Checkpoint-dependent; no single family-wide parameter claim made here.
scale.zh: 依具体检查点而定；本版不为整个系列指定单一参数量。

entries.name: jevos

summary.en: Local yes/no decision model served as GGUF through llama.cpp, with a TypeSafe Jev-compatible request/response shape for `noul` questions.
summary.zh: 通过 llama.cpp 以 GGUF 格式提供本地是非判断，`noul` 请求与响应采用 TypeSafe Jev 的接口格式。

use.en: Experiment with CPU-local reading and triage questions; put the full policy in `instructions` and validate behavior on your own labeled cases.
use.zh: 用于探索 CPU 本地文本判读与分流；将完整规则写入 `instructions`，并用自己的标注样例验证行为。

caveat.en: Yes/no only: `choice` and `score` return 422, and the jevos documentation says `criteria` is accepted but ignored. Wire-format compatibility is not semantic equivalence. Arithmetic/date errors and benchmark sensitivity are author-reported; old README results do not identify v2 performance.
caveat.zh: 仅支持是非判断：`choice`、`score` 返回 422，jevos 文档说明 `criteria` 虽被接受却不参与判断。接口格式兼容不等于语义等价。算术、日期错误及评测敏感性由作者自报；旧版 README 的成绩不能代表 v2。

mechanism.en: The inspected binary runtime reads logits at fixed 0/1 answer-token slots and applies softmax to return P(yes), without text generation. The submitted MiniCPM5 base and 17-layer count remain unestablished; this code path was not executed here.
mechanism.zh: 核读源码的二元模式读取固定 0/1 答案 token 槽的 logits，再通过 softmax 返回 P(yes)，不生成文本。投稿所述 MiniCPM5 基座和 17 层结构仍未确证；本次没有执行这条代码路径。

training.en: Training recipe, dataset and base-checkpoint provenance were not established by the reviewed sources; no independent training reproduction.
training.zh: 核读来源未确证训练配方、数据集和基座检查点来源；没有独立训练复现。

availability.en: The v2 release lists q4_k_m (619,289,280 bytes) and q8_0 GGUF assets. Documentation describes offline CPU use via llama.cpp. Listed hashes are publisher/API metadata, not local binary verification.
availability.zh: v2 发布页列出 q4_k_m（619,289,280 字节）和 q8_0 GGUF 权重，文档说明可通过 llama.cpp 在 CPU 上离线运行。记录的哈希来自发布方/API 元数据，未经本地下载核验。

entries.license_note: Repository LICENSE is MIT; reviewed release metadata does not separately establish base-weight license provenance.

scale.en: Project documentation describes 1B parameters; this review did not inspect the weight tensors or independently count parameters.
scale.zh: 项目文档称为 1B 参数；本次没有检查权重张量或独立核算参数量。

entries.name: Clef / Clef-Flash

summary.en: Multimodal Qwen backbones with a joint schema head for typed decisions and a Jev/SystemOne-compatible wrapper.
summary.zh: 多模态 Qwen 骨干加联合 schema 判断头，输出类型化决策，提供 Jev/SystemOne 兼容封装。

use.en: Compare text/image-based classification, triage and ordinal judgments with task-specific error costs.
use.zh: 比较文本／图像分类、分流与有序评分，并按具体任务衡量错误成本。

caveat.en: Vendor benchmarks have task-specific trade-offs. API compatibility and probability outputs do not establish calibrated business risk; local inference needs the custom schema runtime.
caveat.zh: 厂商评测存在任务间取舍；接口兼容和概率输出不等于业务风险已校准，本地推理需要定制 schema 运行代码。

mechanism.en: Joint transformer head routes state evidence to questions and jointly scores their allowed options in one forward pass; no free-form answer generation.
mechanism.zh: 联合 Transformer 判断头把状态证据路由到问题，在一次前向计算中对各题允许的选项评分，不生成自由文本答案。

training.en: Cloudflare reports rank-256 LoRA plus the routing head, label-smoothed cross-entropy, Brier loss and a secondary RLCD objective on internal synthetic data; the full data/recipe was not audited.
training.zh: Cloudflare 称使用 rank-256 LoRA 与路由头、标签平滑交叉熵、Brier 损失及辅助 RLCD 目标，训练数据为内部合成数据；完整数据和配方未审计。

availability.en: Public weights and custom load_release_model/systemone helpers; also Workers AI. The hosted Clef page lists 65,536 tokens, while local encode_record defaults to 16,384. Check the specific endpoint schema for supported media and truncation.
availability.zh: 公开权重及定制 load_release_model／systemone 函数，另有 Workers AI。Clef 托管页面列 65,536 token，本地 encode_record 默认 16,384；媒体支持与截断行为须核对具体接口。

entries.license_note: Both reviewed release cards declare Apache-2.0; this does not establish that all training data or the full training recipe are public.

scale.en: Cards describe Clef as 27B (Qwen3.8-27B) and Clef-Flash as 9B (Qwen3.5-9B), each retaining a vision encoder; parameter counts are source-reported.
scale.zh: 模型卡称 Clef 为 27B（Qwen3.8-27B），Clef-Flash 为 9B（Qwen3.5-9B），均保留视觉编码器；参数量为来源自报。

entries.name: Strands Decider

summary.en: Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4 pointer-head family; October v1 releases average three trained adapters/heads and then calibrate.
summary.zh: Qwen3.5 与 Gemma 4 pointer-head 系列；10 月 v1 发布平均三个训练适配器／判断头后再校准。

use.en: A local baseline for short classification and domain-supervised decisions; test question changes, option order and risk–coverage on your own traffic.
use.zh: 可作为短文本分类和领域监督判断的本地基线；用实际流量测试问题变化、选项顺序和风险—覆盖率。

caveat.en: Five v1 seed-0 configs are now public, but Qwen mix builders/four inputs plus teacher distributions and Gemma code_v27 remain missing. Several dev evaluations have train splits in the mix. E2B index predates a CUDA attention fix; Qwen v1 missing-image overconfidence worsens on POPE. E07/E08 remain historical, not current guarantees.
caveat.zh: 已公开五份 v1 seed-0 配置，但 Qwen 混合构建器／四项输入及教师分布、Gemma code_v27 仍缺失。若干 dev 评测对应训练划分已用于训练。E2B index 先于 CUDA 注意力修复；Qwen v1 缺图时 POPE 过度自信恶化。E07／E08 保留为历史，不能当作当前保证。

mechanism.en: Replaces the language-model head with a dynamic pointer readout comparing the answer-position state to option-token states; one forward pass for noul, choice or score. Confidence is derived from the distribution, not a separate correctness predictor.
mechanism.zh: 以动态 pointer 读出替代语言模型输出头，比较答案位置与选项 token 的隐状态，一次前向计算支持 noul、choice、score。置信度由分布推导，并非独立正确率预测器。

training.en: Qwen v1: 246678 balanced rows, Gemma-4-31B teacher and v19 KL anchor. Gemma v1: 135602 rows, Qwen3.5-4B teacher and v19 anchor. Three-seed soups store rank-48 LoRA plus three readouts; recipes differ by family. Published seed-0 settings and input hashes improve traceability, not complete data replay. Oct19 init_from now continues trained text adapter+head, including soups, enforces checkpoint architecture and resets temperatures; recalibrate after adaptation. Vision load explicitly rejects training. No new adapted-model quality result.
training.zh: Qwen v1：246678 条平衡样本、Gemma-4-31B 教师与 v19 KL 锚点。Gemma v1：135602 条样本、Qwen3.5-4B 教师与 v19 锚点。三种子平均保存 rank-48 LoRA 与三个读出头；不同系列配方不同。 公开 seed-0 设置与输入哈希改善可追溯性，不等于完整数据可重放。 10 月 19 日 init_from 改为继续训练已训文本 adapter＋head（含 soup），强制匹配架构并清空温度，适配后须重校准；视觉加载明确拒绝训练，未新增适配效果证据。

availability.en: Current Qwen: strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610; four Gemma v1 sizes are text-only and need runtime main at the reviewed revision. Separate base weights; 4096-token trained/served window. v19/v21 remain published. Oct16 main fixes request-local pointer offsets/tokenizer concurrency and aligns torch eval/calibrate with serving preparation; MLX is not supported by eval/calibrate. Revalidate probabilities/calibration per backend; no new weight/score claim.
availability.zh: 当前 Qwen 为 strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610；四种 Gemma v1 仅文本，所核版本需运行库 main。另需基座权重，训练／服务窗口 4096 token；v19／v21 继续发布。 10 月 16 日 main 修复每请求 pointer 偏移／分词并发，并让 torch 评测／校准使用服务准备流程；eval／calibrate 不支持 MLX。按后端重验概率／校准，不推断新权重或成绩。

entries.license_note: Repository and published adapter/head declare Apache-2.0. The release contains adapter/head files only; base weights load separately. Check base-model and dataset terms separately.

scale.en: Qwen3.5 2B and Gemma 4 E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B; active MoE size does not equal resident weight memory.
scale.zh: Qwen3.5 2B 与 Gemma 4 E2B／E4B／12B／26B-A4B；MoE 激活参数量不等于驻留权重内存。

summary.en: Few-shot sentence-transformer adaptation followed by a classification head.
summary.zh: 少样本句向量适配，再训练分类头。

use.en: Fixed-label tasks with labeled examples.
use.zh: 有标注数据的固定标签任务。

caveat.en: Not an arbitrary typed-question API.
caveat.zh: 不等于任意类型化问题接口。

summary.en: Task-trained query/document reranking.
summary.zh: 面向查询与文档的任务专用重排。

use.en: A relevant baseline before training a general candidate selector.
use.zh: 训练通用选择器之前应测试的相关性基线。

caveat.en: A relevance score is not a probability of business correctness.
caveat.zh: 相关性分数不是业务正确概率。

summary.en: Constrained structured output for ordinary language models.
summary.zh: 为普通语言模型提供受约束结构化输出。

use.en: Separate the benefit of an output contract from the benefit of a new model.
use.zh: 区分输出约束的收益与新模型的收益。

caveat.en: Schema validity does not guarantee factual validity.
caveat.zh: 模式合法不保证事实正确。

summary.en: A tabular foundation model for classification and regression.
summary.zh: 用于表格分类与回归的基础模型。

use.en: Structured numerical/categorical inputs; an adjacent alternative, not a direct Jev replacement.
use.zh: 数值与类别型输入；属于相邻方案，不是 Jev 的直接替代。

caveat.en: Paper-level inclusion; no local reproduction or natural-language claim.
caveat.zh: 按论文收录；未本地复现，不外推自然语言能力。

summary.en: Routes between stronger and cheaper language models using learned signals.
summary.zh: 利用学习到的信号在强模型与便宜模型间路由。

use.en: Quality/cost routing baselines.
use.zh: 质量与成本权衡的路由基线。

caveat.en: Performance depends on the model pair, traffic and router training distribution.
caveat.zh: 效果依赖候选模型、流量与路由训练分布。

summary.en: Research infrastructure for building and comparing routing strategies.
summary.zh: 构建和比较路由策略的研究基础设施。

use.en: Compare alternative routers using common quality/cost measurements.
use.zh: 在共同质量与成本指标下比较路由方法。

caveat.en: The August 2026 paper is a preprint; do not equate infrastructure with a proven best policy.
caveat.zh: 2026 年 8 月论文为预印本；基础设施不是已证明的最优策略。

summary.en: Online-learning and contextual-bandit tooling.
summary.zh: 在线学习与上下文老虎机工具。

use.en: Decisions whose feedback is observed only for the action taken.
use.zh: 只能观察已执行动作反馈的决策问题。

caveat.en: Requires appropriate logging, exploration and evaluation assumptions.
caveat.zh: 需要合适的日志、探索与评估假设。

summary.en: Prediction-set, uncertainty and conformal-risk tooling.
summary.zh: 预测集合、不确定性与保形风险工具。

use.en: Separate risk control from the model generating a score.
use.zh: 将风险控制与生成分数的模型分开。

caveat.en: Guarantees depend on the procedure, target risk and data assumptions.
caveat.zh: 保证依赖方法、风险目标及数据假设。

entries.name: HF-hosted Decision Index (archival releases and live board)

summary.en: A broader decision benchmark index with explicit aggregation rules.
summary.zh: 具有明确聚合规则的较广覆盖决策评测指数。

use.en: Inspect task coverage and aggregation before interpreting a ranking.
use.zh: 先检查任务覆盖和聚合方式，再解读排序。

caveat.en: Oct14-generated 0.3.2 aggregate JSON inspected on Oct15; private items/raw runs remain unaudited. Text uses a 0.9-point tie band. Archive scoring versions separately: 0.3.2 includes scoring/data corrections, not evidence of retraining. This community index is separate from Artificial Analysis Decision Index 1.0; do not merge rankings or score labels. Current v0.4 text Full is private-only 60/40 same-skill/new-domain with a revised hidden domain set; public no longer contributes. Vision remains 50/50 public/private. Do not compare 0.3.2 and 0.4 Full as a model gain; archived pins survive removed live files.
caveat.zh: 10 月 15 日核对了 10 月 14 日生成的 0.3.2 汇总 JSON，私有题目／原始运行仍未审计。文本榜有 0.9 分平局带；0.3.2 含评分／数据修正，不能据此推断重训。 此社区指数与 Artificial Analysis Decision Index 1.0 分属不同协议，不合并排名或成绩标签。 当前 v0.4 文本 Full 为纯私有同技能／新领域 60／40，隐藏新领域集合也修订；公共不再计入。视觉仍为公共／私有 50／50。不能将 0.3.2→0.4 Full 差异当模型增益；上游移除在线旧文件后仍保留历史固定来源。

summary.en: Human-reference subsets, paired comparisons and calibration reporting.
summary.zh: 人工参考标签子集、配对比较及校准报告。

use.en: A useful protocol to inspect and adapt, with artifact limitations recorded.
use.zh: 可检查并借鉴协议，同时保留产物公开范围限制。

caveat.en: Project-author-run, not independently reproduced by this list.
caveat.zh: 由项目方运行；本列表未独立复现。

summary.en: Third-party code and protocols for decision-model comparisons.
summary.zh: 用于判断模型比较的第三方代码与协议。

use.en: A second perspective beyond model authors.
use.zh: 提供模型作者之外的另一种观察。

caveat.en: Third-party status alone does not certify methodology or labels.
caveat.zh: 第三方身份本身不保证方法或标签可靠。

summary.en: Why log loss and other proper scores target truthful distributions.
summary.zh: 为什么对数损失等适当评分规则以真实分布为目标。

use.en: Start with what a probability score means.
use.zh: 先理解概率评分的含义。

caveat.en: An ideal optimization target is not proof of deployment calibration.
caveat.zh: 理想优化目标不等于部署已校准。

entries.name: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks (2017)

summary.en: Empirical calibration and post-hoc temperature scaling.
summary.zh: 经验校准及事后温度缩放。

use.en: Understand calibration as a measured property.
use.zh: 把校准理解为需要测量的性质。

caveat.en: Calibration cannot repair incorrect rankings or missing evidence.
caveat.zh: 校准不能修复错误排序或证据缺失。

summary.en: Classification with abstention and risk/coverage trade-offs.
summary.zh: 带拒判的分类与风险／覆盖率权衡。

use.en: Measure how much work can be safely automated.
use.zh: 测量有多少工作能在风险限制下自动处理。

caveat.en: Source experiments are not guarantees for unrelated LLM tasks.
caveat.zh: 原始实验不是无关 LLM 任务的保证。

entries.name: Learning to Defer to an Expert (2020)

summary.en: Jointly learn prediction and handoff to an expert.
summary.zh: 联合学习预测与向专家交接。

use.en: Model executor complementarity, not task difficulty alone.
use.zh: 学习执行者互补性，而非仅给任务打难度分。

caveat.en: Humans and tools are not assumed infallible.
caveat.zh: 不能假设人工与工具不会犯错。

summary.en: Calibrate risk-controlling procedures under stated conditions.
summary.zh: 在明确条件下校准风险控制程序。

use.en: Separate a statistical guarantee from a confidence field.
use.zh: 区分统计保证与置信度字段。

caveat.en: Read exchangeability, loss and monotonicity assumptions.

entries.name: Perplexity Decider v1 / v1.1 / v1.2 (27B / Flash 4B)

summary.en: v1.2 joint-request decision heads on Qwen3.8-27B and distilled Qwen3.5-4B; retain v1/v1.1 as distinct artifacts.
summary.zh: v1.2 联合请求答码头：Qwen3.8-27B 及蒸馏 Qwen3.5-4B；保留 v1／v1.1 的独立产物身份。

use.en: A self-hosted comparator for text/image judgments after task-specific validation.
use.zh: 经具体任务验证后，作为文本／图像判读的自部署对照。

caveat.en: Author card comparisons mix training and request-format changes, so gains do not isolate either cause. Public-task training exposure is not proof of exact test leakage. Grouping helps some tasks and hurts candidate ranking, especially Flash. No new universal accuracy, calibration or cost recommendation.
caveat.zh: 作者对比同时改变训练与请求格式，不能隔离归因；训练任务暴露不等于具体测试泄漏。分组可改善部分任务，也可损害候选排序，Flash 尤甚；不形成通用准确率、校准或成本推荐。

mechanism.en: v1.2 reads 255-code heads at each question marker. Full attention spans all questions in a request; linear attention stays causal. Grouped questions influence each other; use separate requests for independent candidates. Packing isolates requests, unlike grouping inside one request.
mechanism.zh: v1.2 在每题标记处读 255 答码头；full-attention 覆盖同请求所有问题，linear-attention 仍因果。组内问题相互影响，独立候选宜分请求；跨请求 packing 保持隔离，不等于请求内分组。

training.en: v1.2 retrains with more data including official benchmark training splits; test decontamination is author-described. Flash distills full teacher distributions and soups runs. Temperatures 1.382 (27B) / 1.554 (Flash) fitted in joint format, distinct from v1/v1.1; changed grouping/backend requires recalibration checks. Full data replay remains unaudited.
training.zh: v1.2 增加数据并使用官方基准训练划分，测试去污染为作者披露；Flash 蒸馏教师完整分布并平均权重。联合格式温度 27B 为 1.382、Flash 为 1.554，区别于 v1／v1.1；改变分组／后端须重验校准，完整数据重放未审计。

availability.en: v1.2 cards/tree public-readable; residual private-repository wording and untested tensor access noted. Text/images at saved 1.6MP; 262144 configured length versus about 32k training, beyond that only long-log spot checks. Overlength splits question groups retaining state/images, changing joint semantics; a single overlong question rejects, never truncates. BF16 fast path permits near-tie differences; FP8 moves probabilities further. Latest tag-only commits do not change weights.
availability.zh: v1.2 卡片／目录可公开阅读，仍有私有库措辞，未测试张量下载。文本／图像按保存的 1.6MP 配置；可配置 262144 长度，训练约 32k，之外仅长日志点测。超长拆问题组并保留状态／图像，会改变联合语义；单题超长拒绝，不截断。BF16 fast 有近似平局差异，FP8 概率偏移更大；最新标签提交不改变权重。

scale.en: 27B Qwen3.8 and Flash 4B Qwen3.5; distinct head sizes and calibrators.
scale.zh: 27B Qwen3.8 与 Flash 4B Qwen3.5；头维度、校准器分别匹配。

mechanism.zh: POST /v1/decisions：input 加命名的 predicate／choice／score 问题；answers 为数组。

entries.name: Nace Drex v1.5 / v2.0

summary.en: Text-only Kev-pointer family: v1.5 uses MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B; v2.0 uses the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B language tower.
summary.zh: 仅文本 Kev pointer 系列：v1.5 使用 MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B，v2.0 使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的语言骨干。

use.en: Local candidate for text/JSON decisions, including long inputs.
use.zh: 本地文本／JSON 判断候选，可测试长输入。

caveat.en: v1.5 uses benchmark training splits; its results are not unseen-domain zero-shot. Public Index 0.3.1 leaders fall inside its tie band. Small runner checks do not establish broad parity. v2.0 JevBench author counts trail Jev 1.13.0 by two items (E32); this is not a significance result or a universal win. Current snapshot is not proven identical to evaluated weights.
caveat.zh: v1.5 使用基准训练划分，其结果不能视为未知领域零样本；公开 Index 0.3.1 前列处于平局带内，小规模运行器核对不证明普遍等价。 v2.0 作者 JevBench 计数比 Jev 1.13.0 少两题（E32），不作显著性或普遍胜出结论；当前 snapshot 与实测权重未建立同一性。

scale.en: v1.5 approximately 9B; v2.0 author describes 35B total/~3B active, 256 experts/8 active. Active size is not resident weight memory; tensors not independently counted.
scale.zh: v1.5 约 9B；v2.0 作者称总量 35B／激活约 3B，256 专家中激活 8 个。激活规模不等于驻留权重内存，未独立统计张量。

mechanism.en: Pointer head scores supplied noul/choice/score options without generation, per question. v2.0 runtime extracts Qwen3_5Moe language_model and drops vision; hybrid questions are independent causal rows. Fork runtimes can share state prefixes.
mechanism.zh: pointer head 每题对给定 noul／choice／score 候选评分而不生成。v2.0 运行时提取 Qwen3_5Moe language_model 并舍弃视觉，混合骨干的各题为独立因果 row；分支运行库可共享状态前缀。

training.en: v1.5 discloses official benchmark training splits plus procedural data. Full v2.0 training/decontamination/calibration artifacts remain unverified; do not transfer v1.5 recipe details or temperatures to v2.0.
training.zh: v1.5 披露使用官方基准训练划分加程序生成数据。完整 v2.0 训练／去污染／校准产物仍未核实，不能将 v1.5 配方细节或温度移植给 v2.0。

availability.en: Python CUDA and Nace llama.cpp/Ollama forks; default state-plus-one-question limit 16384, configurable maximum 131072. v2.0 HF snapshot/card/config plus 16 shard and head LFS identities reviewed; no tensors downloaded or parity tested. Base vision packaging does not establish image input support. Oct23 Q4_K_M Apple path adds Kapitsa v0.2.15 shared-state branches/cache; defaults separately cap state, branch, packed request and sequence at 16384. Hardware-fit/short-ticket medians do not establish quantized decision quality, calibration or 131072-context accuracy.
availability.zh: Python CUDA 及 Nace llama.cpp／Ollama 分支；状态加一题默认上限 16384、可配置最大 131072。已核 v2.0 HF snapshot／卡／配置、16 分片及 head 的 LFS 标识，未下载张量或测试等价；基座视觉包装不证明支持图像输入。 10 月 23 日 Q4_K_M 苹果路径新增 Kapitsa v0.2.15 共享状态分支／缓存；状态、分支、整包及序列各默认限 16384。硬件可装载／短工单中位延迟不证明量化决策质量、校准或 131072 长度准确率。

entries.license_note: Code Apache-2.0; weights use modified Nace.AI Open RAIL-M with commercial thresholds, competitor exclusions and use restrictions. Public access does not imply unrestricted open source.

entries.name: vLLM-SR Decision 3.0

summary.en: Six multimodal code-readout checkpoints; native vLLM main support added October 14, with an independent prompt read per question.
summary.zh: 六个多模态 code-readout 检查点；10 月 14 日新增原生 vLLM main 支持，每题仍独立读取 prompt。

use.en: Local text/image/video classification, scoring and routing; compare sizes at fixed input and candidate budgets.
use.zh: 本地文本／图像／视频分类、评分与路由；固定输入和候选预算比较各型号。

caveat.en: Index versions and public-only scores differ. In the Oct15 snapshot, weight/calibration identities were unchanged and the text numerical leader shared the top tie band. That serving review required post-merge/nightly native vLLM; LoRA and CUDA were unmeasured in the integration report.
caveat.zh: Index 各版本与公共分数不可混用；10 月 15 日快照的权重／校准标识未变，文本数值领先者处于共享第一平局带；该次服务核验要求原生 vLLM 合并后／nightly 版本，集成报告未测 LoRA 和 CUDA。

scale.en: Card counts / nominal base labels: d3 26.09B / 27B; flash 8.39B / 9B; mini 4.54B / 4B; nano 2.21B / 2B; lite 0.85B / 0.8B; edge 0.59B / 0.6B. Counts include vision; manifests also count the readout.
scale.zh: 模型卡参数量／宣传基座尺寸：d3 26.09B／27B；flash 8.39B／9B；mini 4.54B／4B；nano 2.21B／2B；lite 0.85B／0.8B；edge 0.59B／0.6B。包含视觉编码器，manifest 另计读出头。

mechanism.en: Last prompt position → 255-code FP32 readout → mask unused codes → temperature 1.0 softmax. Questions have separate state/question/option rows; the package runtime's default batches of 8 do not encode all questions as one shared text sequence. Qwen full-attention layers are noncausal; DeltaNet layers stay causal. The pinned package choice/score confidence is 1-H(P)/log(K) for K>1 (one option: 1), a concentration statistic rather than a calibrated probability of correctness; native/backend semantics must be checked separately.
mechanism.zh: 最后 prompt 位置 → 255-code FP32 读出 → 掩蔽未使用 code → 温度 1.0 softmax。每题有独立状态／问题／选项行；包运行库默认 8 行批处理不等于所有问题共用一次序列编码。Qwen full-attention 层双向，DeltaNet 层保持因果。 固定包的 choice／score confidence 为 K>1 时的 1-H(P)/log(K)（单候选为 1），是分布集中度统计量，不是已校准的正确概率；原生／其他后端语义须另查。

training.en: d3 manifest declares Qwen3.8-27B, with qwen3_5 runtime architecture; others declare Qwen3.5, including edge derived from the 0.8B base. Public training data/recipe, overlap audits and held-out calibration reports were not established. Softmax and T=1 do not establish empirical calibration. Separate third-party Vis Decisions 0.6.1 implements text-only full or LoRA adaptation: language backbone/adapters plus a trainable 255-code readout, valid-option CE and merged FP32 export. It strips the vision tower; this does not establish image/video fine-tuning or reproduce the original D3 training recipe.
training.zh: d3 manifest 声明 Qwen3.8-27B，运行架构为 qwen3_5；其他基于 Qwen3.5，edge 也源自 0.8B 基座。完整训练数据／配方、重叠审计及保留集校准报告尚未确证；softmax 和 T=1 不证明经验校准。 独立第三方 Vis Decisions 0.6.1 实现文本 full／LoRA 适配：训练语言骨干／adapter 及完整 255 答码头，使用有效候选 CE 与合并 FP32 导出。它去掉视觉塔，不能证明图像／视频微调，也不等于复现 D3 原始训练配方。

availability.en: v3.1.0 weights retained; custom Transformers and vLLM-SR dev Engine paths remain. Native vLLM /v1/systemone merged as 89cab550 on Oct14; the Oct15 review found stable v0.31.0 predating support. D3 uses classify: no prefix caching/chunked prefill, up to 64 questions and 255 choice options; error/confidence/usage semantics differ from the package runtime. Core ML is separate. Video: 2 fps, at most 32 frames; no audio validation. No verified D3 multimodal fine-tuning recipe established here. Null package token limits and backbone context configuration are not validated long-context quality. The inspected official modeling_d3.py rejects train(True); this wrapper restriction does not rule out separate training implementations such as the text-only Vis path. Generic multimodal PEFT support remains unverified.
availability.zh: 保留 v3.1.0 权重、定制 Transformers 与 vLLM-SR dev Engine。原生 vLLM /v1/systemone 于 10 月 14 日以 89cab550 合入；10 月 15 日核验时的正式版 v0.31.0 早于该支持。D3 走 classify：关闭 prefix cache／chunked prefill，最多 64 题、255 个 choice 选项；错误／confidence／usage 与包运行库不同。Core ML 独立；视频 2 fps、最多 32 帧，未验证音频。本版未确证 D3 多模态微调配方。包中的 null token 上限及骨干上下文配置不等于长上下文质量验收。已阅官方 modeling_d3.py 的 train(True) 拒绝训练；这限制该封装，不排除 Vis 文本路径等独立训练实现。通用多模态 PEFT 支持仍未确证。

entries.license_note: All six pinned cards/manifests declare Apache-2.0 for weights, readout, runtime and listed Qwen bases. Public weights do not establish public training data. Per-package source revisions and author-supplied identity hashes are in the source register; no family-wide weight hash or local binary verification is claimed.

summary.en: Apple deployment resource with native Swift managers and Python-assisted Core ML bridges, including Decision 3.0.
summary.zh: Apple 部署资源，含原生 Swift manager 与 Python 辅助 Core ML bridge，支持 Decision 3.0 等。

use.en: Test a local deployment against its upstream renderer, probabilities, failure handling and task labels.
use.zh: 把本地部署与上游 renderer、概率、失败处理和任务标签逐项核对。

caveat.en: Conversion parity and smoke tests are not quality guarantees. Match length buckets, precision, tokenizer, calibrator and media path; bridge calls queue serially and timeouts close the session. Automatic downloads/environment setup are documented, not run here.
caveat.zh: 转换等价和 smoke test 不保证质量；须匹配长度 bucket、精度、tokenizer、校准器与媒体路径。bridge 调用串行排队，超时会关闭 session；文档中的自动下载／环境安装本轮未运行。

entries.name: Intern-Decision

summary.en: Qwen3.5 multimodal 0.8B/2B/4B family; multiple typed fields scored from one causal masked assistant skeleton.
summary.zh: Qwen3.5 多模态 0.8B／2B／4B 系列，在一个因果 masked assistant skeleton 中评分多个类型化字段。

use.en: Compare multi-field cost and field/order sensitivity against per-question models; test image-grounded judgments.
use.zh: 与每题独立模型比较多字段成本和字段／顺序敏感性，测试基于图像证据的判断。

caveat.en: Private training/calibration records are absent. A 96-case distribution pilot is diagnostic; size/backend-specific temperature and max(P) confidence are not portable business risk guarantees. Paper seven-suite accuracy concerns text tasks; visual trajectories are qualitative. Public Jevbench informed development; matched-data ablations and a matched D3 multimodal comparison are absent from the reviewed evidence.
caveat.zh: 原始训练／校准记录私有；96-case 分布试验只作诊断。型号／后端专属温度与 max(P) confidence 不能直接保证业务风险。 论文七套准确率针对文本任务，视觉轨迹为定性演示；公开 Jevbench 参与开发，已阅证据缺同数据消融及同条件 D3 多模态对照。

scale.en: 0.8B, 2B and 4B nominal Qwen3.5 sizes; independently inspected cards, no local tensor count.
scale.zh: 0.8B、2B、4B 为 Qwen3.5 名义规模；分别核对模型卡，未本地统计张量。

mechanism.en: Reads candidate-token logits immediately before each `<decision>` placeholder in one causal pass; up to 16 fields / 62 options, no free-text generation. Fields share the schema sequence, so order/context invariance needs testing. Confidence=max(P), unlike Jev distribution summaries.
mechanism.zh: 一次因果前向，从每个 `<decision>` 前一位置读取候选 token logits；最多 16 字段／62 选项，不生成自由文本。字段共享 schema 序列，须验证顺序／上下文不变性；confidence=max(P)，不同于 Jev 的分布统计量。

training.en: Decision-tuned language backbone; frozen vision tower/projector. Cards report NLL temperature fitting on 1728 calibration and 1693 separate validation cases: 0.8B T=2.747760550703, 2B T=2.100509348278, 4B T=1.99241824. Private original records and full data construction remain unavailable. Inspected XTuner configuration trains full language parameters with masked full-vocabulary answer-token CE, not LoRA; gold symbols remain labels, while the input retains placeholders. Paper v1 reports 17880 training samples / 23500 decisions, including 5500 image-bearing samples, for full language-backbone tuning with vision/projector frozen. This is not LoRA effectiveness evidence or verification that the full raw training data are public.
training.zh: 微调语言骨干，冻结视觉 tower／projector。卡片称用 1728 校准及 1693 独立验证样本按 NLL 拟合温度：0.8B 为 2.747760550703、2B 为 2.100509348278、4B 为 1.99241824；原始私有记录及完整数据构建未公开。已审阅 XTuner 配置以 masked 完整词表 answer-token CE 训练语言全参数，并非 LoRA；金标答码只在 labels，输入保持占位符。 论文 v1 称有 17880 条训练样本／23500 个决策，其中 5500 条带图；训练语言骨干、冻结视觉塔／projector。它不是 LoRA 效果证据，也不代表已核实完整原始训练数据公开。

availability.en: Public HF weights, own inference.py and repository HF/XTuner paths. HF card default 8192 tokens rejects overlength, up to 8 images. Core ML 0.8B port in FluidUse is text-only and uses smaller fixed buckets; it does not inherit HF image/context support.
availability.zh: 公开 HF 权重、专属 inference.py 及仓库 HF／XTuner 路径。HF 卡默认 8192 token、超长拒绝，最多 8 图；FluidUse 的 Core ML 0.8B 仅文本、较小固定 bucket，不能继承 HF 的图像／上下文支持。

entries.license_note: Three inspected cards declare Apache-2.0 and retained Qwen notices. Check evaluation dataset licenses separately; original training/private calibration records are not released.

entries.name: Verdict / OpenJev
entries.weight_revision: HF repository 8af2496eb63c7fa66d7d234e1f62629380030eb4 (source pin; tensor bytes not locally verified)

summary.en: 151M ModernBERT/GLiClass candidate classifier with an explicit insufficient-evidence option and per-K calibration.
summary.zh: 151M ModernBERT／GLiClass 候选分类器，含显式证据不足选项及 per-K 校准。

use.en: Compact intent classification and missing-option tests; compare native serving probabilities with the exact evaluation renderer/calibrator.
use.zh: 轻量意图分类与缺少正确选项测试；核对实际服务概率和评测 renderer／校准器。

caveat.en: Author tests show abstention collapsing under hard negatives and synonym wording. Converter reports shipped serving calibration differs substantially from the held-out evaluation; no domain-independent abstention guarantee.
caveat.zh: 作者测试显示 hard negative 和同义改写下拒答崩塌；转换者报告实际服务校准与保留集评测明显不同，不能保证跨域拒答可靠性。

scale.en: 151378177 parameters reported; up to 25 logits = 24 substantive candidates plus abstention.
scale.zh: 报告 151378177 参数；最多 25 logits，即 24 个实质候选加拒答项。

mechanism.en: Encoder scores candidates including __insufficient_evidence__, without text generation. Engine renders hypothesis-style descriptions and applies candidate-count temperatures; choosing abstention is a trained candidate decision, not a risk bound.
mechanism.zh: 编码器评分包括 __insufficient_evidence__ 的候选，不生成文本。Engine 使用 hypothesis-style 描述及候选数对应温度；拒答是学习到的候选判断，并非风险上界。

training.en: Author describes CE+Brier post-training with temperature scaling. Shipped per-K/global calibration differs from the single T fitted by the held-out evaluator; original full training provenance and all open-domain fitting splits not independently audited.
training.zh: 作者称使用 CE+Brier 后训练与温度校准；发布的 per-K／全局校准不同于保留集评测拟合的单温度。完整原始训练来源及所有开放域拟合划分未独立审计。

availability.en: Public HF weights/ONNX and Python/WebGPU/WASM paths; 512-token serving budget. Separate Core ML FP16 L128/L512 conversion with full rendered-request limits; LUT8 package failed conversion acceptance and is not validated.
availability.zh: 公开 HF 权重／ONNX 及 Python／WebGPU／WASM 路径，服务预算 512 token。独立 Core ML FP16 L128／L512 转换须遵守完整请求长度；LUT8 未通过转换验收，不属于已验证包。

entries.license_note: Pinned model card and repository declare Apache-2.0; base and dataset terms remain separate. An OpenJev name denotes this independent project, not an official TypeSafe release.

summary.en: Original-evaluator comparison of Jev and supervised text/TF-IDF models on earnings, 8-K labels and SEC follow-up.
summary.zh: 原评测者比较 Jev 与监督文本／TF-IDF 模型，分别测试财报变化、8-K 标签和 SEC 后续问询。

use.en: Test task/label alignment and supervised baselines before selecting typed judgments.
use.zh: 先核任务／标签对齐和监督基线，再选择类型化判断。

caveat.en: Vendor API support; historical selected populations, hindsight screening, post-hoc prompts and split limitations. No universal tree-versus-Jev winner or investment-return claim.
caveat.zh: 厂商提供 API；历史筛选样本含回顾检查、事后提示和划分限制，不能宣布树模型／Jev 通用胜负或投资收益。

summary.en: LLM-proposed questions and Jev judgments turn text into features for a supervised CatBoost predictor.
summary.zh: LLM 提议问题，Jev 将文本转成语义特征，再由监督 CatBoost 预测任务标签。

use.en: Compare direct judgments, ordinary text features and frozen semantic features at matched label/inference budgets.
use.zh: 在相同标签／推理预算下比较直接判断、普通文本特征和冻结的语义特征。

caveat.en: Author-reported wine regression. Feature discovery belongs inside development folds; downstream training does not fine-tune Jev or establish financial/multimodal generalization.
caveat.zh: 葡萄酒回归属于作者报告；特征发现须限制在开发划分，训练下游模型不等于微调 Jev，也不证明金融／多模态泛化。

summary.en: Parallel 23-class scene and 23-class dialogue-intent tasks, official full-SFT baseline, and sourced gold/silver/bronze methods and semifinal scores.
summary.zh: 并列的 23 类场景／23 类对话意图任务、官方 full-SFT 基线，以及有来源的金银铜方法和复赛成绩。

use.en: Study task/label/IO contracts and compare data augmentation, retrieval, adaptation and merging as separate hypotheses; follow the linked case before domain experiments.
use.zh: 研究任务／标签／输入输出契约，将数据增强、检索、适配及合并作为分别检验的假设；领域实验前先看专门案例。

caveat.en: Composite final prizes differ from online F1 ranks. E33 records official semifinal scores; E28 preserves author EcomMIR task results. Pseudo-label exposure and missing exact artifacts limit causal claims, replay and domain transfer.
caveat.zh: 综合最终奖项与线上 F1 排名不同；E33 保存官方复赛成绩，E28 保留 EcomMIR 作者分任务结果。伪标签接触与精确产物缺失限制归因、重放和跨域结论。

summary.en: Inspectable per-question candidate CE+Brier, replay and temperature fitting on a Qwen3.5 text-training path.
summary.zh: 可检查的逐题候选 CE＋Brier、回放及温度拟合，训练路径使用 Qwen3.5 文本输入。

use.en: Study a bounded training/readout baseline before implementing a matched multimodal candidate scorer.
use.zh: 实现同骨干多模态候选评分前，研究有明确边界的训练／读出基线。

caveat.en: Not an image fine-tuning implementation. MIT covers code only; some training data are non-commercial or lack stated terms. No training or calibration result reproduced here.
caveat.zh: 不是图像微调实现；MIT 仅覆盖代码，部分训练数据为非商业许可或未说明条款；未在此复现训练或校准。

summary.en: Text-state teacher/simulator labels train a small option-distribution LoRA student.
summary.zh: 用文本状态的教师／模拟器标签训练小型候选分布 LoRA 学生。

use.en: Inspect distillation inputs and retain both domain and generic regression sets.
use.zh: 检查蒸馏输入，保留领域任务及通用能力回归集。

caveat.en: Game-specific author reports include lost generality. Not image-training or customer-support transfer evidence; complete data/evaluated artifacts not audited.
caveat.zh: 游戏专项作者报告同时存在通用能力下降；不证明图像训练或客服泛化，完整数据／评测产物未审计。

entries.name: StartLux-Decision v1.1 (Instant / AutoThink)

summary.en: Option-letter LM readout: Instant uses prompt-bidirectional full-attention; causal AutoThink conditionally reasons and fuses two distributions.
summary.zh: 使用 LM 选项字母读出：Instant 的 full-attention 提示双向，因果 AutoThink 按需推理并混合两次分布。

use.en: Compare one-pass versus selective computation on evidence-complete decisions, at matched risk and complete cost; commercial use requires separate weight authorization.
use.zh: 在证据充分的判断上以相同风险与总成本比较一次读出和选择性计算；商业使用权重需另获授权。

caveat.en: Public DI is development-selected, not the full/private board. DecisionPivot is author-built/evaluated. Gate 0.9 paper results do not describe current 0.6 defaults; confidence/none signals need policy-specific validation.
caveat.zh: 公共 DI 参与开发选择，并非完整／私有榜；DecisionPivot 为作者自建自测。论文 0.9 门槛成绩不代表当前 0.6 默认；confidence／none 须按实际策略验证。

scale.en: Five Instant nominal sizes: 0.8B/2B/4B/9B/27B; AutoThink: 4B/9B/27B. Cards separately pinned; no independent tensor count.
scale.zh: Instant 五个名义规模：0.8B／2B／4B／9B／27B；AutoThink 为 4B／9B／27B。各卡固定版本，未独立统计张量。

mechanism.en: No new classifier head: selected existing LM A–Z rows, up to 26 candidates/readout; longer lists use group/final tournaments. Each question is a separate row. Instant changes full-attention only; linear-attention layers stay causal. AutoThink keeps causal attention, gates on max(P), and normally fuses 25% initial + 75% post-thought. API confidence is a different statistic.
mechanism.zh: 不新增分类头：选已有 LM 的 A–Z 行，每次最多 26 候选，长列表分组／决赛归约；每题独立 row。Instant 仅改 full-attention，linear-attention 保持因果；AutoThink 全因果，以 max(P) 开门，通常初判 25%＋后判 75%；API confidence 是不同统计量。

training.en: Paper: full-language SFT; merged adapters/data/attention specialization and Instant seed-weight averaging; causal reasoning supervision then RLCD². Vision frozen. RLCD² uses a frozen starting scorer, proper-score difference and soft length penalty with group-relative policy gradients. Public inference plus archived v1 text LoRA does not establish the complete v1.1 training/data package.
training.zh: 论文：语言全参数 SFT；adapter／数据／注意力适配后合并，Instant 多种子权重平均；因果推理监督后接 RLCD²，视觉冻结。RLCD² 由冻结起始评分器计算 proper-score 差值及软长度惩罚，以 group-relative policy gradients 优化推理；公开推理加归档 v1 文本 LoRA 不等于完整 v1.1 训练／数据包。

availability.en: Inspected vLLM/llama.cpp/MLX/Transformers paths, not executed. Accuracy release vLLM 0.19.1 is text-only; launcher 0.31 enables up to 8 images, video=0. Default Instant context cap 131072; causal configuration 262144, not verified full-context quality. AutoThink default gate 0.6/budget 4096, loop handling and 4000-character tail; full latency includes reasoning and reread. Oct17 fixes normalize list-form criteria/options before tournament routing (including a 26-choice none slot); optional vLLM extra now pins 0.31.0. Eight card revisions are unchanged; no new measured gain. Prism adds NVIDIA GGUF serving for causal v1/v1.1 AutoThink, not Instant. Shared-state/cache/quantization parity claims are author-tested only; allow_none defaults on. Quantization calibration is separate from probability calibration.
availability.zh: 已阅 vLLM／llama.cpp／MLX／Transformers 路径，未运行。成绩发布用 vLLM 0.19.1 仅文本；launcher 0.31 最多八图、video=0。默认 Instant 上限 131072，因果配置 262144，不等于全长度质量验证。AutoThink 默认门槛 0.6／预算 4096，含循环处理及末 4000 字符后读；总延迟须含推理与再读出。 10 月 17 日修复将列表式 criteria／options 先规范化再做分组归约，含 26 选项另加 none 的情况；可选 vLLM 依赖现固定 0.31.0。八卡 revision 未变，无新增实测增益。 Prism 新增 NVIDIA GGUF 服务，仅覆盖因果 v1／v1.1 AutoThink，不覆盖 Instant。共享状态／缓存／量化等价仅为作者测试；allow_none 默认开启。量化校准不同于概率校准。

entries.license_note: Inference code Apache-2.0; all eight inspected v1.1 cards declare CC BY-NC 4.0 weights. Commercial use requires a separate license. Training/reference dataset and backbone terms remain separate; no unrestricted open-source model claim. Prism own code has no selected license at reviewed revision; do not extend the Apache license of vendored files to it.

summary.en: 13 generated contrast families, programmatic labels and public generator/solver/scoring assets; separate reused-public-task reference track.
summary.zh: 13 个生成对比家族、程序标签及公开生成／求解／评分资产，另有复用公共任务参考轨。

use.en: Test response to answer-changing details, pair correctness and selective behavior; pin dataset version and system/run mapping.
use.zh: 测试答案关键细节敏感性、成对正确与选择性行为，固定数据版本和系统／运行映射。

caveat.en: StartLux-author benchmark and runs, not third-party reproduction. Corrected v1.1 and intermediate tables must not be silently equated to the paper release scores. Hindsight coverage metrics are not deployment risk guarantees.
caveat.zh: StartLux 作者自建与运行，不是第三方复现。修正版 v1.1 及中间检查点表不能静默等同论文最终成绩；事后覆盖指标不是部署风险保证。

summary.en: Version 1.0 combines knowledge/hallucination, text HLE, tool calling and safety classification with four equal weights.
summary.zh: 1.0 版以四等权部分组合知识／幻觉、文本 HLE、工具调用与安全分类。

use.en: Compare task coverage, label mapping and aggregation alongside the separate HF-hosted index; review per-task outcomes before selecting a model.
use.zh: 与独立的 HF 托管指数并列核对任务覆盖、标签映射及聚合；选型前查看分任务结果。

caveat.en: 500 knowledge items are private; WildGuardTest is a filtered 835-row subset. Non-hallucination is conditional on not being correct. No current ranks/scores audited; not a calibration, multimodal or full-service latency test.
caveat.zh: 500 道知识题私有；WildGuardTest 为筛选后 835 行。非幻觉率以未答对集合为分母。未审计当前排名／成绩，不能代替校准、多模态或完整服务延迟测试。

entries.name: Calibration and Risk-Budgeted Decisions with System One Models

summary.en: Preprint separates probability calibration from fixed-sequence LTT certification of a binary decision policy under a risk budget.
summary.zh: 预印本将概率校准与固定序列 LTT 对二元风险预算策略的认证分开。

use.en: Define score polarity, conditional risk, fallback and Fit/Cal/Test independence before selecting a threshold family; use as a method candidate with explicit assumptions.
use.zh: 选择阈值族前定义分数方向、条件风险、回退及 Fit／Cal／Test 独立性，作为假设明确的方法候选。

caveat.en: Author-reported six English-text datasets, single seed. The iid same-population guarantee is over calibration samples certifying population FOR, not per-item correctness, arbitrary multiclass/VLM risk or distribution shift. No certificate means policy fallback.
caveat.zh: 作者报告六个英文文本数据集、单种子。同分布 iid 保证针对校准抽样认证总体 FOR，不是逐题正确、多类／VLM 任意风险或分布漂移保证；无证书意味着策略回退。

entries.name: Baseten mammoth-1 / elephant-1

summary.en: Qwen3.5 27B/9B family with option-letter LM readout and block-bidirectional full attention.
summary.zh: Qwen3.5 27B／9B 系列，使用 LM 选项字母读出及分块双向 full-attention。

use.en: Compare independent-question typed decisions with supervised and generative baselines at matched evidence/risk.
use.zh: 以相同证据／风险，与监督和生成基线比较独立问题的类型化判断。

caveat.en: Card says text+image training, report says text-only; image supervision remains unresolved. Repeated public-index feedback, hidden private items and gated data limit independent audit; no imported rank or overall-winner claim.
caveat.zh: 卡片称图文训练，报告称仅文本，图像监督仍有冲突。反复公共指数反馈、隐藏私有题与 gated 数据限制独立审计；不引入排名或总冠军结论。

scale.en: mammoth-1 27B and elephant-1 9B nominal Qwen3.5 derivatives.
scale.zh: mammoth-1 名义 27B、elephant-1 名义 9B，均基于 Qwen3.5。

mechanism.en: Existing LM option logits; shared state prefix and separate question suffixes. Full attention is block-bidirectional; Gated DeltaNet remains causal. Choice up to255, score2–10 levels; output confidence is not a risk certificate.
mechanism.zh: 使用已有 LM 候选 logits；共享状态前缀、问题后缀分离。Full-attention 分块双向，Gated DeltaNet 保持因果；Choice 最多 255、Score 为 2–10 级，confidence 不是风险证书。

training.en: Report: full language-model fine-tuning, frozen vision, CE plus Brier and evolving6.21M-row Mix8. Public benchmark feedback selects data recipes; decontamination is author-described. Brier training does not prove deployment calibration.
training.zh: 报告：语言模型全参微调、视觉冻结，CE 加 Brier，最终 Mix8 为 621 万行。公共基准反馈参与数据配方选择；去污染为作者描述，Brier 训练不证明部署校准。

availability.en: Public HF serving bundle; trained length16384, oversized inputs rejected. Card image-input support is distinct from validated image quality. Historical fixed blobs and tensor identities not independently checked; training dataset access not granted.
availability.zh: 公开 HF 服务包；训练长度 16384，超长拒绝。卡片图像输入支持不同于已验证图像质量；历史固定 blob／张量身份未独立核验，未获取训练数据权限。

entries.license_note: Current mammoth card declares MIT; inspect exact model/base/data terms. No blanket training-data availability claim.

entries.name: Jeffan-31b-1710

summary.en: Gemma-4-31B option-logit decisions with a conditional whole-input reread policy.
summary.zh: Gemma-4-31B 选项 logits 判断，加有条件的整段重复读取策略。

use.en: A text-only comparator for read-once versus selective reread, freezing threshold and full request cost.
use.zh: 用于文本单读与选择性重复读取对照，须冻结阈值并计算完整请求成本。

caveat.en: Training data/recipe and overlap undisclosed. Card 8192 and engine 98304 are different boundaries; public-suite maximum lengths and simulated memory caps do not validate arbitrary context or hardware.
caveat.zh: 训练数据／配方及重叠未披露。卡片 8192 与引擎 98304 是不同边界；公共套件最长样本及模拟显存上限不验证任意上下文或硬件。

scale.en: Gemma-4-31B-it derivative; no independent parameter count.
scale.zh: 基于 Gemma-4-31B-it，未独立统计参数。

mechanism.en: Next-token logits over up to255 option codes; below top-probability0.9 repeats whole input and replaces initial distribution. No candidate permutation; text-only engine leaves vision unused.
mechanism.zh: 在最多 255 个答码上读 next-token logits；最高概率低于 0.9 时重复整段输入并替换初判分布。不做候选置换；文本引擎未使用视觉塔。

training.en: No verified full training recipe or data lineage. Reread is an inference policy, not training disclosure; probabilities lack production validation.
training.zh: 无已验证完整训练配方或数据谱系；重复读取是推理策略，不能当训练披露，概率未做生产验证。

availability.en: Published vLLM0.29 BF16 engine/kit integration; sequential B200 author public-suite run. Count rereads, prefix-cache state and all tokens in latency/cost; no model executed here.
availability.zh: 公开 vLLM0.29 BF16 引擎／评测套件接入；作者公共测试用串行 B200。延迟／成本须计重复读取、前缀缓存状态及全部 token；本仓库未运行模型。

entries.license_note: Fixed license-only source commit declares Apache-2.0 for weights and inference, replacing prior CC BY-NC4.0/MIT. Verify upstream Gemma terms separately; no new weights inferred.

summary.en: Calibration-selected cost-aware ticket routing separates probability calibration from error discrimination.
summary.zh: 按校准集选成本敏感工单路由，分开概率校准和错误区分能力。

use.en: Evaluate abstention under stated error/review costs with supervised baselines, frozen selection and common test items.
use.zh: 在明确错误／复核成本下，以监督基线、冻结选择及同一测试样本评估拒答。

caveat.en: One corpus/random split, unequal taxonomy supervision and historical endpoints. Correct fixed-cost human triage is an assumption; reported costs omit full inference/review expense. External frozen archive not accessed.
caveat.zh: 单语料随机划分，类别监督信息不对等、端点较旧。人工分流总正确且成本固定是设定；报告成本未含完整推理／复核费用，未读取外部冻结档案。

entries.name: Commit or Abstain? Missing Legal Authority

summary.en: Third-party provider comparison exposes wrong acceptance versus unnecessary abstention on constructed CaseHOLD.
summary.zh: 独立于模型提供商的评估，在构造 CaseHOLD 上揭示错误接受与不必要拒答的权衡。

use.en: Use an explicit absent-correct-option test and measure both false commitment and false abstention.
use.zh: 显式构造正确选项缺失测试，同时测错误承诺和误拒答。

caveat.en: One English legal task, synthetic absence, public-text training exposure unresolved. Logged API evaluation is not local reproduction; billed call comparisons omit human-review cost.
caveat.zh: 单一英文法律任务、构造性缺失，公共文本训练暴露未排除；API 日志评估不等于本仓库复现，调用费用对比不含人工复核成本。
